messages:
incident-bot: Pager opened — latency-spike-sev3 on inference-prod. Paging @tara. Symptoms: 95th latency increased, small spike in 5xx. Link: https://incidents.redwood/1759994321
tara: On it. I've taken the primary oncall. Observed 5xx rate ~2% -> started investigating root cause. Will check KV cache and routing first.
sasha: Looking at kvcache logs now. Seeing a burst of evict ops at 2026-03-17T14:12: logs: `evict: shard=12 freed=2048` repeated. Could correlate with churn.
alex: If evictions caused more cold-starts, that can bump latency. Can we temporarily reduce batch size or route traffic to dedicated pool?
priya: Customer impact: small subset of EU customers saw errors. CS report incoming — ETA 10m. Estimated affected sessions ~120 in last 10m. Flagging enterprise accounts on the support queue.
tara: Mitigation step: rolled back kvcache eviction threshold to previous stable value (deployed). Scaling probe increased by +1 instance in eu-west-1. Monitoring charts.
incident-bot: Auto-update: error rate dropped to baseline after rollback. Continued monitoring for 15m.
miguel: Thanks. We should schedule a post-incident review to capture root cause and action items. I'm available tomorrow 11:00 PT, can do a 60m slot.
sasha: Agreed — propose postmortem meeting tomorrow 11:00 PT. Tentative agenda: timeline, root cause hypotheses, action items + owners + sizing, rollout/regression plans.
alex: Draft action items (rough):
- Investigate eviction threshold regression (owner: alex) size: M; target quarter: Q2
- Add regression test for eviction churn (owner: sasha) size: S; target quarter: Q2
- Improve alerting for eviction spikes (owner: priya) size: S; target quarter: Q2
- Run controlled capacity/cold-start test on kvcache under simulated churn (owner: miguel) size: L; target quarter: Q3
- Document rollback playbook and add runbook steps (owner: tara) size: S; target quarter: Q2
priya: I'll create tickets in the remediation board and link them to this incident: https://redwood.in/boards/remediation/INC-1759994321
sasha: Quick priority mapping: P0 -> investigate/regression test, P1 -> alerting + runbook, P2 -> capacity stress test. Add owners and estimates to the tickets.
tara: Also need to loop in platform infra for kernel/driver checks — tagging them in the ticket. For the postmortem, please bring any logs/snippets.
miguel: I'll take ownership of coordinating the follow-ups and making sure action items land in next sprint. Will update the board after the postmortem.
sasha: :thumbsup: I added the tentative agenda and the action items to the calendar event. See you all tomorrow.
priya: Notifying CS with a brief summary now. Closing the active pager once 30m stable window passes.
incident-bot: Pager update: stable for 30m, closing page. Incident severity: S3 — postmortem scheduled.
